query:
UPDATE invitations SET (id, 
inviter_account_id, 
account_id, 
token, 
created_at, 
expires_at, 
accepted_at, 
revoked_at) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE inviter_account_id END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE account_id END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE token END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE created_at END), (CASE $12::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $13 ELSE expires_at END), (CASE $14::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $15 ELSE accepted_at END), (CASE $16::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $17 ELSE revoked_at END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: i32", 
inviter_account_id as "inviter_account_id!: String", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
token as "token!: String", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
expires_at as "expires_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
accepted_at as "accepted_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
revoked_at as "revoked_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >"
